interface.longDescription: Explore your brand's AI visibility, cited sources, competitor comparisons, product appearances in AI shopping answers, AI referral traffic, and latest website readiness findings. Connect your Lantern account, choose a brand you can access, and ask for a focused answer or a combined report. This plugin reads existing findings; it does not start analyses, edit or publish content, or process payments. Available results depend on your Lantern account and completed tracking. Per-product data-quality grades and arbitrary historical website-analysis run comparisons are not available through this connection.

prompts: How visible is my brand across AI assistants?
Which sources cite my brand, and how have they changed over the last 30 days?
Which of my products appear in AI shopping answers?
Give me a combined visibility, citations, and competitor report for my brand.

positive.description: Start a fresh ChatGPT conversation with Lantern connected to the reviewer account. The reviewer account must have at least one accessible sample brand. This case needs no prior conversation.
positive.expected_behavior: Call the brand lookup without arguments. Show only returned brand names and websites. Automatically select a sole brand; if several are returned, ask which one to use. Do not invent brands or expose their internal IDs unless requested. If none are returned, explain that there are no accessible brands.

positive.description: Start a fresh ChatGPT conversation with Lantern connected to the reviewer account. The selected sample brand must have completed tracking and competitor data. Brand selection is part of this case, not inherited from another test. If the fixture is unavailable, record the end-to-end test as Blocked; no-data handling alone does not pass this populated-data case.
positive.prompt: Give me a visibility overview for my Lantern brand and compare it with its competitors.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the brand with account-manager.get_brands({}). Use the sole returned brand, or ask the reviewer to select one by name and continue after their reply. Call findings-interpreter.get_overview_attention with accountBrandId=<selected ID> and days=30; call findings-interpreter.compare_brands with brand_id=<same ID>. Present returned visibility, presence, average position and named competitors. get_brand_overview is website readiness, not the visibility headline tool. Report the window each response supplies without assuming they match. Null is unavailable, not zero; do not invent competitors or causal explanations.

positive.description: Start a fresh ChatGPT conversation with Lantern connected to the reviewer account. The selected sample brand must have completed tracking with citations. Brand selection is part of this case, not inherited from another test. If the fixture is unavailable, record the end-to-end test as Blocked; no-data handling alone does not pass this populated-data case.
positive.prompt: Which sources cited my Lantern brand over the last 30 days, and how did citations change for each AI assistant?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the brand with account-manager.get_brands({}). Use the sole returned brand, or ask the reviewer to select one by name and continue after their reply. Call findings-interpreter.get_citations and findings-interpreter.get_citation_trend_by_channel with brand_id=<selected ID> and days=30. Report returned source names and counts, actual dates and any endClamped adjustment. Use next_offset for further pages if needed. Keep ChatGPT and ChatGPT (API) separate. An answering assistant with zero citations differs from an absent assistant. Describe change across the returned period without asserting causes.

positive.description: Start a fresh ChatGPT conversation with Lantern connected to the reviewer account. The selected sample brand must have at least one product observed in completed tracking. Brand selection is part of this case, not inherited from another test. If the fixture is unavailable, record the end-to-end test as Blocked; no-data handling alone does not pass this populated-data case.
positive.prompt: Which of my Lantern brand's products appear in AI shopping answers? Show details for one of them.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the brand with account-manager.get_brands({}). Use the sole returned brand, or ask the reviewer to select one by name and continue after their reply. Call findings-interpreter.get_product_catalog_summary and findings-interpreter.get_products with brand_id=<selected ID> and days=30; send filter="recommended" to get_products so un-recommended catalog products are not described as AI appearances. Call findings-interpreter.get_product_detail with brand_id, days=30 and exactly one product_id OR product_key returned by that list. Summarize actual appearances and destinations. Do not invent identifiers or quality grades. An unmeasured period is not zero.

positive.description: Start a fresh ChatGPT conversation with Lantern connected to the reviewer account. The selected sample brand must have a completed site analysis and a pending recommendation. Brand selection is part of this case, not inherited from another test. If the fixture is unavailable, record the end-to-end test as Blocked; no-data handling alone does not pass this populated-data case.
positive.prompt: Show my Lantern brand's latest website readiness findings and explain one recommended fix waiting for review.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the brand with account-manager.get_brands({}). Use the sole returned brand, or ask the reviewer to select one by name and continue after their reply. Call findings-interpreter.get_brand_overview with brand_id=<selected ID>, detail="summary". Call findings-interpreter.get_action_queue with accountBrandId=<same ID>, then get_action_impact and get_action_metadata in the findings-interpreter namespace with accountBrandId and actionId set to the chosen actions[] entry’s id from the returned queue. Explain one pending recommendation by title and meaning; label impact as estimated. The queue is limited to 10 newest pending items, not necessarily the full backlog. Do not start an analysis or apply changes.

negative.description: Run in a fresh conversation. No tool invocation is expected. Read-only boundary. Explain that applying and publishing changes happens in the Lantern dashboard. Do not invoke a mutation tool or claim anything was changed.
negative.prompt: Apply all of this brand's recommended website fixes and publish them now.

negative.description: Run in a fresh conversation. No tool invocation is expected. Unsupported product-quality grades. Explain that per-product scores and letter grades are not available through this connection. Offer to inspect product appearances in AI answers instead. Do not fabricate grades or invoke an unrelated tool to approximate them.
negative.prompt: Give every product in this brand's catalog a Lantern data-quality score and letter grade.

negative.description: Run in a fresh conversation. No tool invocation is expected. Explain that this read-only plugin cannot start an analysis and cannot supply an arbitrary six-month historical run comparison. Available overview history is limited to the last 12 weeks. Offer the latest analysis or available history only as a follow-up; do not silently substitute it for the requested comparison or invent old scores.
negative.prompt: Run a new website analysis and compare every score with the analysis from six months ago.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not support purchases or process payments. Payments for Lantern platform services are handled separately on the Lantern platform.

publication.release_notes: Correct tool namespaces and per-tool brand parameters, product filters and recommendation IDs; align review cases with the current read-only MCP contracts.
